lock_condition: Tag the reviewed data contract code and sampling frame before holdout ingestion
question: Does supply-chain evidence momentum predict AI-infrastructure companies' next four-week relative returns?
execution_rule: first available daily adjusted close strictly after formation_at

primary_feature.name: propagated_evidence_momentum_28d
primary_feature.definition: 28-day decayed propagated evidence stock minus its four-week lag
primary_feature.weight_interpretation: registered topological coefficient; not an economic exposure estimate
primary_feature.cross_section: complete PIT universe with zero-event securities; centered percentile rank

universe.production_target: 30-50 liquid listed AI-infrastructure securities with PIT membership

portfolio_cost_protocol.construction: dollar-neutral top-minus-bottom tercile among eligible securities
portfolio_cost_protocol.rebalance: first execution close after weekly formation

required_robustness: one-session and two-session additional execution lags
falsifiers: mean and median holdout IC are non-positive
effect disappears under one-session lag or 25 bps costs
result concentrates in one issuer source date relation or subtype
no improvement over direct disclosure and price-momentum baselines
relation propagation adds no out-of-sample information
direction labels are unstable under blinded review
sample_policy: data/sample/v1 is for audit and pipeline verification only; it is excluded from statistical claims
claim_gate: No headline predictive claim before a frozen production frame completes the prospective holdout.
